abstract: ai-ready is a Claude Code plugin that makes repositories AI ready: it maps a repo's components, prunes stale docs, keeps CLAUDE.md lean, and checks in hooks and CI that changes keep it that way.

components.name: checker
components.responsibility: The stdlib-only checker: doc checks, CLAUDE.md budget, component map checks, discovery, explain and test verification.

components.name: skill
components.responsibility: The make-ai-ready skill: understand the repo, prune docs, write a lean CLAUDE.md, plan, enforce.

components.name: benchmark
components.responsibility: Before/after token and cost benchmark of the skill on a target repo (needs network and an API key; no tests of its own).
